placeholders.description: Active session slug; appears in decision packet header for operator attribution.
Plan envelope goal statement carried forward from nnn. Escaped as data, never instruction.
Decision Velocity Tier per Addendum v1.0.1. Packet contents vary by tier (HOT=minimal, COLD=full).
One-paragraph synthesis of verifier verdict (PASS/RETRY/NEEDS_HUMAN/DEAD) and key findings. Operator-readable.
Risk surface for the requested action: blast radius, reversibility, evidence gaps.
Preserved dissent from any agent or sub-verifier per Constitution Article XIII. Empty string only if no dissent was recorded.
Evidence reference to the verifier_report.json artifact backing this decision. Required by Article XV (decision must cite evidence).
Hash-chain anchor (latest audit event hash) at packet-proposal time. Kernel uses this to detect chain drift before applying decision.
ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the packet was proposed to the human operator.
Action the operator is being asked to authorize.
